paras: It is Friday night in Milan, and the Brazilian delegation is at a welcome dinner. Flavia sits next to Marco, a partner from the chamber of commerce. After a long week of meetings, nobody wants to talk about numbers. Marco asks a simple question: 'How do you stay healthy on a trip like this?'

Flavia smiles. She used to skip her workout on work trips, and she used to eat fast food in the hotel. 'I was always tired,' she says. Now her health is a priority. She goes to the hotel gym every morning, she stretches after each workout, and she sleeps eight hours. 'It takes discipline,' she says, 'but my routine gives me energy.'

Marco says he used to run marathons, but now he only walks to the office. They agree that recovery and a positive mindset are important for well-being. At the end of the dinner, Flavia says: 'Speaking of discipline, it is the same in my projects at Sebrae.' Marco laughs. Small talk about life can open the door to good business.

gapfill.text: At a dinner, keep it personal and positive. Talk about your routine, your well-being, and a habit that changed: 'I used to..., but now I...'. Then you can use 'Speaking of...' to connect your life to your work.

listenings.text: Welcome back to Work and Wellness. Today's topic is travel. When you travel for work, your routine disappears. You sleep in a new bed, you eat at restaurants, and the meetings never end. So, here are three simple tips. First, keep one small habit from home. For example, a ten-minute workout in your hotel room. Second, walk. Walk to your meetings when you can. And third, protect your sleep. Sleep is the best recovery there is. A short routine is better than no routine. See you next week.

Good evening, and welcome to the Hotel Duomo in Milan. We hope you enjoy your stay. Our gym is on the first floor, and it is open from six in the morning to ten at night. Every day at seven in the morning, there is a free yoga class by the pool. Our restaurant serves breakfast from six thirty to ten thirty. On Sunday, the spa is free for all our guests. If you need anything, please call the reception. Have a relaxing evening.

extra_audio.text: First, I answer the question with a short, friendly opener. Then, I share one habit from my routine. Next, I say how it changed: I used to skip my workout, but now I go every morning. After that, I ask the other person a question back. Finally, I use speaking of to connect my life to my work.
